description.text: The core deliverable of a physical therapist is not a set of movements but an adjustable treatment plan and medical record documentation based on functional assessment, goals, dosage, patient response, and retest results. Converted into setting measurable goals with the patient. When judging this career path, the work loop, responsibility boundaries, evidence standards, risk control, and observable entry-level work should be verified at the same time.

subject.name: Physical therapists
subject.summary: Physical therapists assess patients' movement and functional problems, develop and adjust physical therapy plans, deliver treatment, retest progress, and guide patients in self-management. In the United States a DPT degree and state licensure are usually required; the qualifications and duties of similar rehabilitation therapy positions in China must be verified separately and cannot be directly mutually recognized.
